_comment: H3-DDG model, BindingGYM's OWN inter-assay training recipe. Values traced to /home/guoj0f/repos/BindingGYM/training/{main.py,run.sh,dataset.py}. Compare config/train_h3-ddg_bindinggym.json, which follows H3-DDG's Appendix A.4 instead.
_comment_from_bindinggym: batch_size 8 (run.sh, overriding main.py's argparse default of 48); lr 1e-3, AdamW betas (0.9,0.99), weight_decay 0.05, eps 1e-5, OneCycleLR (main.py:402-403); steps_per_epoch 256 = dataset.py's __len__ of batch_size*256 divided by batch_size; max_epochs 100 and patience 3 (main.py:234-236).
_comment_max_epochs: Official is 100. Capped at 40 to fit a 7h walltime: patience-3 early stopping on the selection metric normally fires well before this, and --resume continues if it does not.
_comment_select: Official early-stops on the FULL held-out fold every epoch, which costs ~0.5h/epoch here. We use a fixed evenly-spaced 500-rows-per-assay subsample for selection, then score the selected weights once on the full fold.
